title: [CQ-R10d4] Agent headless launch spec
description:
Objective: make CQ-R10b's JOBS start the real CLIs headless, with the CQ-R10d1 shim as their only MCP server and a per-role prompt that begins with moe.get_context.

Split from CQ-R10d (task-90847011) on 2026-10-29. The human chose FULL ACCESS INSIDE THE VM. The VM, the moe-agent identity, NoNewPrivs and the scoped bridge are the boundary: claude runs with --dangerously-skip-permissions, and codex with --sandbox danger-full-access, because codex 0.148+ refuses every MCP tool under any sandbox when approval is 'never' (scripts/CLAUDE.md). It depends on:
- CQ-R10d1 (task-9faf1ef3), for the shim path /opt/moe/bin/moe-mcp-shim;
- CQ-R10d3 (task-b8e7ad92), which edits guest-supervisor.py first.

Contract (scripts/local-runner/guest-supervisor.py):
- JOBS[cli] gains a fixed argv template beside its executable and credential names. Keep the shape CQ-R10c's AGENT_JOBS drift test reads, or update that test in the same diff.
- claude:
  - start_job writes <home>/.moe-mcp.json naming only {"mcpServers": {"moe": {"command": "/opt/moe/bin/moe-mcp-shim"}}};
  - argv is [exe, '-p', PROMPT[role], '--mcp-config', <that file>, '--strict-mcp-config', '--dangerously-skip-permissions'].
- codex:
  - CODEX_HOME=<home>/.codex, whose config.toml has only the moe server pointing at the shim, with tool approval 'approve';
  - argv is [exe, 'exec', '--sandbox', 'danger-full-access', PROMPT[role]].
- Never a --resume, --continue or resume subcommand.
- The job runs in WORKSPACE. The config files are created in the fresh session home and owned by the agent, and no other MCP config is reachable: no user or project MCP files.
- PROMPT[role] are fixed strings for worker and qa, each starting with an instruction to call moe.get_context.

Out of scope: the binaries (CQ-R10d2/R10d3), lifecycle, leases and termination (CQ-R10), certification (CQ-R13), and any verified-local or isolation claim.

Verification command (fresh, exit 0 required): node --test scripts/tests/local-runner-bridge.test.mjs scripts/tests/local-runner-agents.test.mjs (on WSL: env -i with the nvm Node 24 PATH).
definitionOfDone: Each cli and role starts with exactly its fixed argv: headless, full access, no resume or continue flag, and the role's prompt beginning with moe.get_context. A recorder test pins it.

The session MCP configuration names only the shim (claude with --strict-mcp-config; codex's config.toml with only the moe server). It is created in the fresh session home and owned by the agent. Shown by tests.
A real job through main() with a fake CLI shows the argv, cwd WORKSPACE and the configuration file contents. Shown by tests.
The verification command exits 0 with its output supplied to complete_task.
taskRails: No direct .moe edits; no Git-write commands by agents; wrappers own landing.
Do not enable verified-local or claim isolation until all requisite implementation and certification gates pass.
